verdict.rationale: Elastic's own docs say the product offers data retention with tiered storage, so a first-party retention capability exists. The pack never shows how users set retention periods or delete data. Missing for 10: documented user-configurable retention periods/policies, data deletion or purge controls, API/automation access to retention settings, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can control data retention and deletion

citations.quote: offers scalable, cost-efficient data retention with tiered storage
